newsitem.title: CANADA: Gold stocks attract heavy Toronto trading.
newsitem.headline: Gold stocks attract heavy Toronto trading.

text.p: Gold stocks caught the interest of Toronto investors again Monday as the gold spot price edged up.
Kinross Gold Corp was up C$0.25 to C$11.25 in heavy trading of almost 800,000 shares.
Barrick Gold Corp and its takeover target Arequipa Resources Ltd were also heavily traded. The takeover was expected to close Monday night at midnight.
"There's momentum in the golds," said one trader who asked not to be named.
"The gold sector in general is turning around."
Drilling and exploration results have been abundant recently, drawing attention to the sector, the trader said.
"They're popping up one by one," he said. "It's a sign gold stocks want to go up further."
But Greenstone Resources Ltd lost almost nine percent of its value in morning trading, falling C$1.85 to C$19.65, the Toronto Stock Exchange's loss leader for Monday morning.
The stock has been rumored as a possible takeover candidate, said market strategist Bob Boaz at James Capel Canada.
"I think the theme in the market over the next six months is going to be consolidation in the industry," Boaz said.
"You'll get the big players who have fairly hefty cash positions buying out some of the nice junior plays."
